items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: And we played for Dr. Dale, we didn't have a name.

ctx.x: Where did you get the name from?

Nope, I don't remember. Is that from the Mardi Gras Indians or something? No, no. This name, I think it came from one of the guys that played Nolan. His father used to go down around Old Sulfur hunting and fishing and whatnot. And this is kind of the language that people spoke down there. And this is about the closest thing we could, this is the only thing that we could remember, really. So we just took that name. And no, we didn't really take that name. No, we made up a little number and we played on the radio…
So did, uh, what did, uh, what did Shawee, uh, record? Do you remember that first record they did for special? Didn't it? No, it was a ladder for, for a ladder.
